title: Adams County woman sentenced in connection with toddler's death, records show
text:
Hawkins and her boyfriend, Brian Moser, were arrested after emergency crews responded to a call July 2, 2025 about an unresponsive 2-year-old.
ADAMS COUNTY , Ohio - A Tri-State woman was sentenced to prison Wednesday for her connection with the death of a toddler at an Adams County apartment, according to court documents.
Tien Hawkins was sentenced to five years in prison after she pleaded guilty to child endangering and three counts of permitting child abuse, records show.were arrested after emergency crews responded to a call July 2, 2025 about an unresponsive 2-year-old at the Timber Ridge Apartment Complex, according to the Adams County Sheriff’s Office. A preliminary autopsy found that Burkhardt died of suffocation. Adams County Prosecutor Aaron Haslam said Lilith and her two young sisters were found with significant injuries.
“He was the one doing the actual child endangering,” Haslam said. “What I can tell you is the mother was permitting this abuse to go on. That she knew about it and allowed it to continue. ”Burkhardt was found unresponsive by Hawkins and Moser.
“I don’t know if they suffocated last night or what,” Moser is heard saying in the 911 call placed the day the toddler was found. “There’s no way. She’s dead. I just woke up and found her.
” At the time of Moser’s arrest, Adams County Prosecutor Aaron Haslam said he was an acting guardian and failed to protect the child.
